def three_sum(xs):
    xs = sorted(xs)
    out = []
    n = len(xs)
    for i in range(n - 2):
        if i and xs[i] == xs[i - 1]: continue
        lo, hi = i + 1, n - 1
        while lo < hi:
            s = xs[i] + xs[lo] + xs[hi]
            if s == 0:
                out.append([xs[i], xs[lo], xs[hi]])
                while lo < hi and xs[lo] == xs[lo + 1]: lo += 1
                while lo < hi and xs[hi] == xs[hi - 1]: hi -= 1
                lo += 1; hi -= 1
            elif s < 0: lo += 1
            else: hi -= 1
    return out
```
